turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Who decided on that zero, and why did Owen find out from his phone in the middle of a class instead of from a phone call to me?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
Before you came in today, or before you entered the zero on November 3rd? Because nobody called me before that mark went in, and your own procedure says somebody should have. Was Owen heard first?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.

Then you'll have that in writing from her. Show me. And since "policy is policy", section 4.2 says I get a call before any mark goes in, and 4.3 says the software alone doesn't establish anything, so tell me which part of your policy you followed.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.

"A courtesy." I'm writing that down. The courtesy your policy required was a phone call before November 3rd, so either you show me something other than a machine's guess, or I'm in the principal's office before I leave this building.
